title: The Morning Digest: November 7, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $98.32 on Friday, up 3 cents, and WTI Dec26 settled at $90.83, up 31 cents (Bloomberg via Rigzone), closing a week in which front-month futures fell about 13.2 percent, the biggest weekly percentage loss since 2022. Enbridge reported third quarter adjusted EBITDA of C$4.434 billion, reaffirmed 2026 guidance, and said the Mainline is at or near capacity and expected to remain in apportionment for the foreseeable future. December WCS is -$29.67 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 6) on zero lots, a second straight zero-lot tightening, while the traded Houston strip tightened on 685 to 745 lots a tenor and the December export spread widened to +$10.73. Positioning on the Nov 3 vintage shows managed money cut Brent net length by 63,487 contracts before Wednesday's fall. The validated diesel crack is $91.10.
